critical_code_review_comments: progress_tracking.py is 955 lines — borderline above the 700-line module threshold. Consider splitting into progress/router.py, progress/trajectory.py, progress/narrative.py, progress/growth_card.py, progress/checkout.py for maintainability.
Test fixture used `name` field for player list; spec note in review mentioned `display_name`. Backend returns `name` (matches DB). Either is fine but document the field name in API spec.

Trajectory endpoint returns {profile, trajectory} envelope but the spec described a flat trajectory object. The frontend handles it correctly; if external API consumers exist, document the envelope explicitly.
